Learn More About The Chef's Quad-Timer Professional

Green burners are still cooking, red burners are done. Whether preparing a healthy supper for family or a seven-course meal for close friends, the Chef's Quad-Timer makes multi-tasking easy. But the Quad-Timer is not about intuitive function alone. The Chef's Quad-Timer Professional is simply the best-looking kitchen timer product on the market today - designed to compliment, rather than clutter, your high-end kitchen.

Here's how it works. The Quad-Timer's four-burner metaphor makes it easy to associate what's cooking on the stove with what's being timed ... at a glance. First, twist the inner silver dial to select the burner you're cooking on. Next, use the outer ring to add or remove time from the display. Press the start button to begin timing (that burner turns green) and then repeat for as many other dishes as you like.

Expired timers chime and flash a red indicator. As an added convenience, expired timers count up to indicate overage in the event that you were out of the room when your dish completed. A convenient batch cooking function makes repeated timing tasks (such as batches of cookies) quick and easy. Recall the last timer value entered with one click.

All four timers may be adjusted, paused, recalled (for batch cooking) or reset independently for maximum flexibility. A convenient clock mode allows the Quad-Timer to double as an attractive kitchen timepiece when not in use. Runs for a year or more on two AAA batteries (included).
